chain.label: Industry/FAA hiring-oversight deficiencies
chain.trigger: the Federal Aviation Administration's failure to implement the pilot records database in a sufficiently robust and timely manner; Atlas' HR reliance on a designated agent to review pilot background records was inappropriate

chain.label: FO's history of training failures and weak flying aptitude/stress response
chain.trigger: the first officer had fundamental weaknesses in his flying aptitude and stress response

caused_by.evidence: systemic deficiencies in the aviation industry's selection and performance measurement practices, which failed to address the first officer's aptitude-related deficiencies

chain.label: Light turbulence encounter penetrating cold front
chain.trigger: aircraft load factors consistent with the airplane encountering light turbulence were recorded

chain.label: Likely IMC associated with cold front penetration
chain.trigger: the airplane was beginning to penetrate the leading edge of a cold front, within which associated windshear and instrument meteorological conditions...were likely

chain.label: Inadvertent go-around mode activation
chain.trigger: the inadvertent activation of the go-around mode likely resulted from unintended contact between the FO's left wrist or watch and the left go-around switch due to turbulence-induced loads that moved his arm

caused_by.evidence: turbulence-induced loads that moved his arm

chain.label: FO's pitch-up somatogravic illusion
chain.trigger: the first officer likely experienced a pitch-up somatogravic illusion as the airplane accelerated due to the inadvertent activation of the go-around mode

caused_by.evidence: the airplane accelerated due to the inadvertent activation of the go-around mode, which prompted him to push forward
the accident airplane was likely flying in IMC when the go-around mode was activated

chain.label: FO's forward/nose-down elevator inputs
chain.trigger: manual forward elevator control column inputs that were applied seconds after the inadvertent activation of the go-around mode were likely made by the FO

caused_by.evidence: which prompted him to push forward on the elevator control column
fundamental weaknesses in his flying aptitude and stress response that further degraded his ability to accurately assess the airplane's state and respond with appropriate procedures

chain.label: Captain's diverted attention from monitoring
chain.trigger: while the captain was setting up the approach and communicating with air traffic control, his attention was diverted from monitoring the airplane's state

chain.label: Captain's failure to command positive transfer of control
chain.trigger: the captain's failure to command a positive transfer of control of the airplane as soon as he attempted to intervene on the controls enabled the first officer to continue to force the airplane into a steepening dive

caused_by.evidence: which delayed his recognition of and response to the first officer's unexpected actions that placed the airplane in a dive
the captain took hold of the left control column and started pulling back, countering the FO's continued nose-down control inputs

chain.label: Airplane entered unrecoverable steep dive
chain.trigger: the airplane's nose-down pitch during this time progressed rapidly to about 49° nose down, and the airplane entered a steep descent

caused_by.evidence: placed the airplane in a steep descent from which the crew did not recover
enabled the first officer to continue to force the airplane into a steepening dive

chain.label: Crash into Trinity Bay marsh
chain.trigger: crashed into a shallow, muddy marsh area of Trinity Bay, Texas

caused_by.evidence: the airplane entered a steep descent from which the crew did not recover... crashed into the marsh

chain.label: Fatal injuries to all three occupants
chain.trigger: The captain, first officer, and a nonrevenue pilot riding in the jumpseat died

caused_by.evidence: was destroyed after it rapidly descended...and crashed into a shallow, muddy marsh area
